newsitem.title: USA: US budget balance unlikely to last long--Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: US budget balance unlikely to last long--Greenspan.

text.p: Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan on Tuesday said he hoped a trend toward declining budget deficits would lead to a balanced budget in the near future but he said the situation probably would not last long.
"The really tough budget work, I regret, is in front of Congress," Greenspan said in response to a question during his Humphrey-Hawkins testimony.
The Fed chief said demographic factors point to rising deficits in the years ahead.
